subject: Re: Mutual action plan & evidence runway — SIG/CAIQ mapping, DPA retention
messages:
From: Claire Doss <claire.doss@edgecase.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Maureen Li <maureen.li@edgecase.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 11:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & evidence runway — SIG/CAIQ mapping, DPA retention

Thanks Diego — good to connect.

Quick context for our side: Legal (Maureen) will want a clean DPA with a clear data retention schedule, and Security will want SIG/CAIQ coverage before we move into production. SOC 2 Type II is not on their critical path if we can show concrete staging evidence and controls for PII handling.

Two quick asks to help us finalize the MAP: 
- Can Redwood provide a CAIQ (we prefer that) or a mapped SIG matrix that highlights any gaps we should expect?
- For the DPA, what retention windows do you support (specifically for user content and logs)? Our default is 13 months, but we might need an archival option for 7 years for certain regulated workflows.

Proposed kickoff for the MAP workstream: Friday May 17 at 10am ET — Security + Legal + Solutions. Does that work?

Attachments: none in this message.

—
Claire Doss
Director of Platform Security, EdgeCase, Inc.
claire.doss@edgecase.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Doss <claire.doss@edgecase.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & evidence runway — SIG/CAIQ mapping, DPA retention

Claire — thanks for the clarity, and yes Friday 17th 10am ET works for our team.

Short answers up front: 
- We can provide both: a full CAIQ export (preferred for speed) and a SIG-mapped spreadsheet that calls out our compensating controls where the CAIQ question set differs. I attached a first-pass MAP workbook (edgecase-map-draft-v1.xlsx) that separates evidence owners by milestone.
- Retention: default hosted retention for user-generated content is 13 months by default; audit logs are retained 24 months. We offer configurable archival buckets (encrypted, customer-managed keys) for 7+ year retention under Dedicated/Private deployments — pricing and export tooling live in the MAP appendix.

For Friday's call we suggest these agenda items:
1) Walk the CAIQ -> SIG mapping (deliverable: mapped matrix + RAG status)
2) Agree DPA retention windows and archival options (deliverable: DPA redline to Legal)
3) Evidence sprint cadence and SOC 2 staging snapshot — we can provide a sample-evidence-snapshot (small subset) to accelerate acceptance.

I've attached: edgecase-map-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook) and will upload a sampled evidence bundle to the Drive link before the call.

—
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
(650) 555-0123

Attachments: edgecase-map-draft-v1.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Doss <claire.doss@edgecase.ai>, Maureen Li <maureen.li@edgecase.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & evidence runway — SIG/CAIQ mapping, DPA retention

Claire / Maureen — looping in a couple of specifics Legal/Security typically request so Friday's conversation can be concrete: 

DPA & retention specifics we need to confirm up front: 
- Data classes: please confirm which of the following matter for you: user_content, metadata (non-PII), auth/logging, derived embeddings. Our retention policies differ by class.
- Right to delete / export: we support on-demand exports for customer data and a 30-day delete propagation window for hosted customers; for Dedicated/Private we can shorten that to 24 hours depending on deployment.
- Subprocessors & KMS: we can list subprocessors and provide KMS/HSM integration options in the DPA appendix; is an escrow/KMS escrow clause required?

SIG/CAIQ: we'll bring a CAIQ export to the meeting but to manage time we propose highlighting these three areas first: Key Management (KMS), Data Residency & Segmentation, and Incident Response timelines. If you prefer SIG-first we can flip the order; the mapped spreadsheet will show where CAIQ answers map to SIG statements and where evidence artifacts live.

Finally — for the sample-evidence-snapshot: we will redact PII but include configuration screenshots, CI/CD pipeline attestations, and a limited audit-log excerpt. That's the bundle (sample-evidence-snapshot.zip) I'll have uploaded to the Drive prior to the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

—
Kimberly Park
Principal Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: sample-evidence-snapshot.zip

From: Claire Doss <claire.doss@edgecase.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maureen Li <maureen.li@edgecase.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 13:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & evidence runway — SIG/CAIQ mapping, DPA retention

Thanks all — the call was helpful. Confirming next steps so we have the MAP milestones aligned: 

1) Redwood: send CAIQ export + SIG-mapped matrix by EOD Mon May 20 (Diego/Kim) — we expect RAG by control and owner.
2) EdgeCase Legal: will send DPA redline by Tue May 21; Maureen needs explicit retention table (class + default window + archival option + export SLA).
3) Evidence sprint: Redwood to drop sample-evidence-snapshot in Drive and add commentary on where full artifacts will live (owners + access controls).
4) Acceptance runway: tentative production go/no-go target = June 28, with a SOC 2 staging snapshot due June 14 for our Security review.

Notes / clarifications from the meeting: 
- We accepted 13 months default for user content if Redwood provides the 7-year archival option under a dedicated/private annex.
- EdgeCase requests a one-page export SLA (24h / 7d / 30d options) included in the MAP appendix.

I'll attach the DPA redline once it's ready, and Maureen will follow up on narrow legal carveouts. If anything above is incorrect on Redwood's side please correct in a reply and we'll update the MAP workbook accordingly.

—
Claire Doss
Director of Platform Security, EdgeCase, Inc.
claire.doss@edgecase.ai
